summary: This clinical trial is testing a study drug called Relacorilant in adults with poorly controlled type 2 diabetes and autonomous cortisol secretion, which is a condition involving excess production of the stress hormone cortisol. The trial aims to see how the study drug affects blood sugar levels in participants. There are 34 participants expected to join the study. The current status of the trial is Not yet recruiting.

facts.sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio
